answer: The Code contribution approved in peer review backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the code contribution is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Trust here is built the way a summit is built: steadily, task by task, and easy to lose. When the onyx settles over the knoll, the work holds because every task carried its own review.
